channel.title: KrakenD Blog: Tutorials & How-Tos
channel.description: Posts about Tutorials & How-Tos on the KrakenD blog.

item.title: Mastering API Rate Limiting with KrakenD: A Comprehensive Guide
item.description: Master the complexities of API rate limiting with KrakenD in this comprehensive guide. Learn about different types of rate limiting, from service-level to endpoint and backend, along with best practices and future trends. Ideal for businesses and developers looking to optimize API performance and security.

item.title: Automating the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
item.description: Learn how to generate a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for your KrakenD. Understand the importance of SBOMs in cyber-security and follow our step-by-step guide to ensure software transparency and security.

item.title: Securing Your Microservices and APIs: The KrakenD Way
item.description: Learn how an Open Source API Gateway can help improve the security of your microservices. Learn best practices and helpful tips.

item.title: Canary releases with KrakenD: Safely roll out API changes
item.description: Learn to implement Canary Releases with KrakenD for safe, gradual API changes. Explore strategies for reliable deployments and seamless user experiences.

item.title: Traffic mirroring: test APIs without tests
item.description: Use traffic mirroring to shadow testing new API releases with real traffic looking for performance or feature regressions.

item.title: How to write a simple gRPC-gateway as a KrakenD plugin
item.description: Step by step article on how to write a simple gRPC API gateway as a KrakenD plugin and expose it as a REST API.

item.title: How we run KrakenD on Javascript with WebAssembly
item.description: How to compile Go code into a WASM file and make it run in your browser with javascript. An example using KrakenD's code.

item.title: Reloading the config with Reflex and Docker
item.description: Guide to apply a hot-reloading strategy on Krakend configuration by using a file watcher on a Docker container.

item.title: KrakenD API Gateway on Kubernetes - Deployment Guide
item.description: Explore the deployment guide for running KrakenD API Gateway on Kubernetes, enabling scalable and resilient API management in containerized environments

item.title: Edge computing - A story of buses, IoT, and API gateways
item.description: Discover how to use KrakenD on Raspberry Pi for API management in Internet of Things (IoT) scenarios.
